**Schreier's lemma.** Let \(G\) be a [[algebra-groups/group|group]] generated by \(S\), let \(H\le G\) be a [[algebra-groups/subgroup|subgroup]], and choose a right transversal \(T\) for \(H\) in \(G\). For \(g\in G\), write \(\overline g\in T\) for the unique representative of the right coset \(Hg\).

Then \(H\) is generated by
\[
t\,u\,(\overline{tu})^{-1}
\qquad (t\in T,\ u\in S\cup S^{-1}).
\]
If \(S=S^{-1}\), it suffices to let \(u\) range over \(S\).

## Remarks

This is a core tool for proving results about generators of subgroups, including the [[algebra-groups/nielsen-schreier-theorem|Nielsen–Schreier theorem]].
